lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a regular grid-like formation across the dorsal and upper-lateral surfaces.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance blobs are precisely positioned at the vertices where vertical and longitudinal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running parallel to the central axis, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from highlighted peaks to shadowed troughs.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique labyrinthine or maze-like patterning of pale dermal ridges forming concentric circles around the primary high-luminance blobs.
